notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run and no human review. The upstream environment needs Python 3.11 or newer, Gymnasium, numpy, MuJoCo and shapely (pyproject.toml:9 and :22-30), and the gate never imports the clone, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py); it was not compared with the upstream environment, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The real space sizes depend on num_movers: the observation array is num_movers*4 values and the action is num_movers*2 values (defaults 1 mover, 4 observation values and 2 action values); the fake uses the default 1 mover, a 2-value action and a 4-value observation, and its initial positions, bounds and contact parameters are placeholders, not facts. The fidelity timestep is 40 ms: 40 control cycles of the 0.001 s default MuJoCo timestep. Five warnings are expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1, because the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call, and four G8.NO_UNIT for the inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values[*], and seed in reset and seed). Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
